card.name: Word after "increased risk" in warnings
card.fires_on: The small word "of" right after "increased risk" in NSAID cardiovascular warnings. It also fires on a comma in a list of fracture sites after "increased risk for" fractures.

modes.label: "of" after increased risk
modes.description: The word "of" directly following "increased risk" before a named adverse event.
modes.example: have shown an increased risk<< of>> serious cardiovascular (CV) thrombotic

modes.label: Comma in fracture site list
modes.description: A comma in a list of fracture sites after a statement about increased risk of fractures.
modes.example: fractures of the hip, wrist<<,>> or spine. The risk of fracture was

card.writes: It suppresses words like probability, odds and chance, so the next word is more likely to name a specific harm than a word for likelihood.
card.plain: It fires where a warning says "increased risk of" and a named harm is about to follow, not a word like chance.
